Trace, implement and test: 面试题12. 矩阵中的路径

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    bool exist(vector<vector<char>>& board, string word) {
        int m = board.size(), n = board[0].size();
        int dirs[5] = {-1, 0, 1, 0, -1};
        function<bool(int, int, int)> dfs = [&](int i, int j, int k) -> bool {
            if (k == word.size()) {
                return true;
            }
            if (i < 0 || i >= m || j < 0 || j >= n || board[i][j] != word[k]) {
                return false;
            }
            board[i][j] = '.';
            bool ans = 0;
            for (int l = 0; l < 4; ++l) {
                ans |= dfs(i + dirs[l], j + dirs[l + 1], k + 1);
            }
            board[i][j] = word[k];
            return ans;
        };
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (dfs(i, j, 0)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
};
